senses.en_definition: Come on; let's go. An exclamation expressing an invitation, urging or encouragement, chiefly in Indonesian and Javanese contexts.

messages.en: Come on, hurry down! I'm already waiting downstairs.
Hang on, let me find my keys first. Found them! I'm coming down now!

senses.en_definition: Come on; let's go. An exclamation used to invite, encourage or urge someone to act.

collocations.en: come on, let's all do this together

messages.en: Come on, guys! Everyone's waiting downstairs. Are you ready yet?
Hang on, I'm putting my shoes on. I'll be down in two minutes!

senses.en_definition: Come on; let's go. An emphatic exclamation used to encourage or urge someone to act.

collocations.en: come on, let's all do this together

messages.en: Come on, come down now! Everyone's waiting downstairs. We're going to be late.
All right, I'm coming down. I was just looking for my keys. I've found them now.

collocations.en: pig farming; pigs raised as livestock

messages.en: There's a wild boar behind our house. I've shut the gate.
Don't go outside just yet, okay? I'm going to call the authorities.
